# Peak Client

**Peak Client** - A powerful Minecraft utility mod for Fabric 1.21.1, created by Zenit.

## Features

### Render Modules
- **Fullbright** - Permanent night vision
- **Zoom** - Smooth zoom (hold C key)
- **Hitbox Overlay** - Show entity hitboxes
- **No Hurtcam** - Remove damage camera shake
- **Crosshair Customizer** - Custom crosshair colors and styles
- **Motion Blur** - Motion blur effect
- **Chunk Borders** - Visual chunk boundaries

### Movement Modules
- **Toggle Sprint** - Automatic sprinting
- **Freelook** - Free camera movement (hold R)

### HUD Modules
- **FPS Display** - FPS counter
- **CPS Counter** - Clicks per second
- **Keystrokes** - WASD key display
- **Coordinates** - XYZ position
- **Armor Status** - Armor durability
- **Potion Effects** - Active effect timers
- **Direction HUD** - Compass direction
- **Scoreboard Tweaks** - Custom scoreboard

### Cosmetic Modules
- **Cape Support** - Custom capes
- **Wings** - Animated wings
- **Hat Cosmetics** - 3D hats
- **Particle Trail** - Movement particles

### Utility Modules
- **Waypoints** - Position markers
- **Minimap** - Mini-map (WIP)
- **Auto Sprint** - Auto sprinting
- **Hit Color** - Custom hit colors
- **Block Overlay** - Block selection highlight

## GUI Controls
- **Right Shift** - Open Click GUI
- **C (Hold)** - Zoom (when Zoom module is enabled)

## Building

```bash
# Linux/Mac
./gradlew build

# Windows
gradlew.bat build
